result.title: Robust Deep Prototype Classifiers via Lipschitz Training
result.summary: Robustness and interpretability are interrelated and desirable properties of machine learning models. A model that changes its prediction under imperceptible perturbations behaves inconsistently with human-recognizable features and, hence, is not interpretable. Prototype-based classifiers such as Generalized Learning Vector Quantization address both at once. They are interpretable by construction because they make the decision by comparing the input to the prototypical example; and their hypothesis margin yields a closed form robustness certificate. However, on high-dimensional data, these shallow models need deep embedding networks to achieve high accuracy, and this voids the robustness certificate. The margin is a statement about distances in the embedding space, and an unconstrained network can map an arbitrarily small input perturbation to arbitrarily large attacks in the embedding space. We close this gap with a theorem: if the embedding network is locally L-Lipschitz around a point, and the classifier is ε-robust around its embedding, then the full model is ε/L-robust in the input space. Based on this, we propose a Lipschitz training scheme to achieve L-Lipschitz properties for embedding networks. We evaluate three classification heads (linear, linear Support Vector Machine, and GLVQ) crossed with two embedding networks (standard and Lipschitz-constrained) on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and Imagenette-160, under FGS, PGD and C\&W attacks. The evaluation results show that combining a prototype-based head with a Lipschitz-constrained embedding provides the strongest robustness. This suggests that the Lipschitz constraint provides an additional robustness benefit in addition to the advantage provided by the prototype-based head. Since the Lipschitz constraint is enforced by sampling rather than by construction, the reported robustness is empirical rather than certified.

AI.brief_summary: 论文给出一个定理：若嵌入网络在局部是 L-Lipschitz 且分类头在嵌入处 ε-鲁棒，则整体模型在输入空间为 ε/L 鲁棒；据此提出基于采样的 Lipschitz 训练来约束嵌入网络，并在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、Imagenette-160 上以线性、线性 SVM 和 GLVQ 三种分类头交叉两种嵌入网络，在 FGS、PGD、C&W 攻击下评测，发现原型头加 Lipschitz 约束鲁棒性最强，且报告的是经验而非可证鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: Lipschitz 常数可作为「latent 表示对输入扰动敏感度」的度量，其把嵌入空间鲁棒性折算到输入空间的思路，可能可供核查用于判断 LVR 内部状态是否稳定保留视觉证据；但研究对象是浅层原型分类器与图像分类攻击，与 VLM 推理状态生成、停止决策无直接联系。
